name: Griffet · Gremlet #21
description:
A griffin chick: eagle up front, lion in the back, all fluff in the middle.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Griffet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
